title: #41 Online Materials
prompt: Online materials like music, movies and other forms of content are accessible at no cost. Do you think online materials should be accessed at no cost?

promptSegments.text: Online materials like music, movies and other forms of content are accessible at no cost.
Do you think online materials should be accessed at no cost?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Free access to digital content helps people learn more.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Free access to digital content helps people learn more.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Free access helps people who do not have much money to enjoy good content.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Free access helps people who do not have much money to enjoy good content.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Content creators need money to make their work.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Content creators need money to make their work.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Artists and creators need to earn a living from it.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Artists and creators need to earn a living from it.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Free access to online educational resources is beneficial because it allows people from poor areas to receive a good education, thereby reducing the learning gap.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Free access to online educational resources is beneficial because it allows people from poor areas to receive a good education, thereby reducing the learning gap.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, free content enhances entertainment options for everyone, especially those who cannot afford expensive subscriptions, allowing them to enjoy global entertainment.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, free content enhances entertainment options for everyone, especially those who cannot afford expensive subscriptions, allowing them to enjoy global entertainment.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first point argues that creating high-quality content requires significant effort and resources, meaning creators must be paid for their hard work.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first point argues that creating high-quality content requires significant effort and resources, meaning creators must be paid for their hard work.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Furthermore, creators need financial support to continue making new things, as content creation is a business that requires funding.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Furthermore, creators need financial support to continue making new things, as content creation is a business that requires funding.
